title: BioTuesdays: EXOZ selects Curia as CDMO for NCT
summary: eXoZymes (NASDAQ: EXOZ) has entered into an agreement with closely held contract research, development, and manufacturing organization (CDMO) Curia Global to initiate technology transfer and scale-up activities for N-transcaffeoyltyramine (NCT).
body_markdown:
eXoZymes


(NASDAQ: EXOZ) has entered into an agreement with closely held contract research, development, and manufacturing organization (CDMO) Curia Global to initiate technology transfer and scale-up activities for N-transcaffeoyltyramine (NCT).
